mechanism_narrative: A lower federal funds rate level, indicative of accommodative monetary policy, reduces the discount rate for equity valuation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in low FEDFUNDS periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 4.0% over the past month signals deteriorating labor market conditions, which typically precedes corporate earnings contraction and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In more than 50% of instances where UNRATE > 4.0, the 20-day forward returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and real personal consumption expenditures (both below their 3-month moving averages) indicate a broad-based demand slowdown, which triggers a sell-off in equities and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In more than 40% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS are below 3mo_MA, the 20-day forward returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 3.5% year-over-year), the Federal Reserve's restrictive monetary policy stance compresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In 60% or more of the periods where CPIAUCSL > 3.5%, the 20-day forward returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: A rise in industrial production above its 3-month moving average signals strengthening economic activity, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In more than 40% of instances where INDPRO > 3mo_MA, the 20-day forward returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of housing starts, reflecting strong consumer demand for residential construction, typically supports economic growth and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In more than 40% of instances where HOUST is above its 12-month average, the 20-day forward returns are negative.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in employment (PAYEMS) and decrease in unemployment (UNRATE) signals a tight labor market that may trigger monetary policy tightening, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: In more than 40% of instances where PAYEMS rises >0.5% MoM and UNRATE falls >0.1% MoM, the 20-day forward returns are positive.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 4.5% indicates a restrictive monetary policy stance, which increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: In more than 50% of instances where FEDFUNDS > 4.5, the 60-day forward returns are positive.
